coaching.headline: A clean 30-minute stomp — objectives 24–9, towers 10–4, three big individual games on top of total map control.
coaching.team: Everything clicked: we took the Fangtooths (20, 26), out-towered them 10-4, and The Fey/Serath/Eden all popped. This is the dominant version of the team — objectives 24-9 converted straight to structures.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Repeat the objective-to-tower conversion that took us to 24-9 neutrals and a 10-4 tower lead — and tighten the two leaks: only 3 of 6 won fights cashed, and the 27-minute 5v4 still went 1-1.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey mid (10/2/11) won a favored read into Howitzer — a carry-grade game that anchored the stomp.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Serath jungle (11/5/12) — dominant; controlled neutrals and the tempo of the 24-9 objective lead.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zinx support, 10 assists — comfortable enabling in a stomp.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi offlane (4/2/8), low-death — note Willy Guggenheim went Megacosm/Lifebinder over the Orb-of-Growth core here; the win covered it.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eden carry (6/3/7) into an unfavored Skylar — a clean contributing line in a 24-9 objective stomp.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

the-fey.loadout: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot), augment Natural Infusion, crest Epoch

sources.note: 2 per takedown, 21 takedowns, capped at 30 from the 15th takedown, around 25 min (estimate)
sources.how: +2 per takedown, up to 30: maxed at takedown 15 (around 25 min)

fightBonus.note: 10 per Harvest Nettles hit for 6s; Harvest Nettles comes back every 2s at 48 haste, so up to 3 stacks if every cast hits

fedBy: Tithe of Death (minor): Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.
Nature's Vengeance (passive): Each time The Fey achieves a Takedown she spawns an Untamed Growth from the Enemy Hero's corpse and gains 30% movement speed for 3s.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,718 hero damage a minute, more than 94% of The Fey mid players this patch (37% of the team's). The damage came from Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Megacosm.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one The Fey touched shortened Fly Trap, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 64.2s late, about 53.4s mid-fight); fight right after Fly Trap is spent.
Fly Trap at rank 3: 95s base, about 64.2s by the end (32% shorter) from 48 ability haste: Megacosm 10, Epoch 8, Tithe of Death (minor) 30.

Mid-fight, Natural Infusion (augment) adds up to 30 more (10 per Harvest Nettles hit for 6s; Harvest Nettles comes back every 2s at 48 haste, so up to 3 stacks if every cast hits): Fly Trap about 53.4s (estimate).
Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 21 takedowns, capped at 30 from the 15th takedown, around 25 min (estimate).
21 takedowns (10 kills, 11 assists) fed: Tithe of Death (minor), Nature's Vengeance (passive).
The Fey dealt 51,543 hero damage, 37% of their team's, with +400 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Howitzer (level 16: about 91 magical armor, 71 after penetration; took 26,004 magical damage from heroes, 74% of all hero damage they took) and Bayle (level 16: about 98 magical armor, 78 after penetration; took 35,076 magical damage from heroes, 68% of all hero damage they took) that is about 12% and 11% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 19% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.
Toughness: +250 health; took 22,410 damage, mitigated 12,617, died 2 times.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Megacosm, Vesh, Mind Rot. The Fey has 4 damaging abilities (Untamed Growth, Bramble Patch hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 48 ability haste brought them back 32% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Damage that scales with our health): 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Mind Rot. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; damage that scales with our health), so the same hits paid out twice.

Countered? 2 of the 4 players The Fey killed built magical armor (Howitzer, Bayle). Anti-heal on Grux. Health items on Howitzer, Bayle, Grux raised the %-health damage they took. We killed The Fey 2 times.

Copy it? Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot): 48.8% in 1,932 The Fey midlane games, below the hero's 51.4%; this 3-item core: 69.2% in 133 games, above the 55.8% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

card.lesson: The Fey's takedowns fed Fly Trap: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Fly Trap is used.

haste.name: Tithe of Death
haste.how: +2 per takedown, up to 30: maxed at takedown 15 (around 25 min)

fight.name: Natural Infusion
fight.how: +10 for 6s each time Harvest Nettles hits a hero, up to 3 at once

extras.name: Nature's Vengeance
extras.how: Each takedown spawns an Untamed Growth from the Enemy Hero's corpse and gains 30% movement speed for 3s.

amps.name: Combustion
amps.how: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.

amps.name: Wraith Leggings
amps.how: Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.

amps.name: Megacosm
amps.how: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.

amps.name: Megacosm
amps.how: On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.

amps.name: Vesh
amps.how: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 19% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.

amps.name: Mind Rot
amps.how: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

lead.title: Damage well above normal
lead.text: 1,718 hero damage a minute, more than 94% of The Fey mid players this patch (37% of the team's). The damage came from Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Megacosm.

stacks.title: Every ability hit set off

members.name: Combustion
members.text: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.

members.name: Wraith Leggings
members.text: Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.

members.name: Megacosm
members.text: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.

members.name: Vesh
members.text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.

members.name: Mind Rot
members.text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

stacks.text: 5 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Megacosm, Vesh, Mind Rot. The Fey has 4 damaging abilities (Untamed Growth, Bramble Patch hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 48 ability haste brought them back 32% sooner: more casts, more triggers.

stacks.title: Damage that scales with our health

members.name: Megacosm
members.text: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.

members.name: Mind Rot
members.text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Mind Rot. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; damage that scales with our health), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 2 of the 4 players The Fey killed built magical armor (Howitzer, Bayle).
Health items on Howitzer, Bayle, Grux raised the %-health damage they took.

copy.text: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot): 48.8% in 1,932 The Fey midlane games, below the hero's 51.4%; this 3-item core: 69.2% in 133 games, above the 55.8% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.
